lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance blobs align vertically to form nodes of a grid, though vertical bands of elevated intensity are not clearly resolved from the background.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a superior-high/inferior-low luminance gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark, elongated low-luminance silhouettes (likely commensal organisms) are visible ventral to the pectoral fin and along the lower flank.
